sanskrit: # Text  anastamitabhārūpas tejasāṃ tamasām api | ya eko 'ntar yadantaś ca tejāṃsi ca tamāṃsi ca
l1:
## bod-p01-v01 (1)
un-set-sun-light-form / of-powers / of-darknesses / too / who / one / within / what-end / powers / darknesses // bod-p01
l2: Of unsetting sun-light is His form — of bright powers and of darknesses too. For He is one, within, and powers and darknesses end in Him.
l3:
Light never setting — bright powers, darknesses, all;
one, within, in whom each shine and shadow fall.

sanskrit: sa eva sarvabhūtānāṃ svabhāvaḥ parameśvaraḥ | bhāvajātaṃ hi tasyaiva śaktir īśvaratāmayī
l1:
## bod-p02-v02 (2)
He / of-all-beings / own-nature / supreme-Lord / host-of-things / of-him-alone / power / Lordship-made // bod-p02
l2: He alone is the own-nature of all beings, the supreme Lord. And the whole host of things is His alone — power, shaped as Lordship.
l3:
He alone is every being's own-nature, the supreme Lord;
and the whole host of things — His power, Lordship-made.

sanskrit: śaktiś ca śaktimadrūpād vyatirekam na vāñchati | tādātmyam anayor nityaṃ vahnidāhikayor iva
l1:
## bod-p03-v03 (3)
Power / from-power-possessor-form / difference / does-not-desire / identity / of-these-two / eternal / as / fire-burning // bod-p03
l2: Power wants no apartness from the power-bearer. The two are eternally one — as fire is one with its burning.
l3:
Power wants no parting from her bearer — never, ever;
the two are eternally one — as fire is one with burning.

sanskrit: sa eva bhairavo devo jagadbharaṇalakṣaṇaḥ | svātmādṛṣe samagraṃ hi yacchaktyā pratibimbitam
l1:
## bod-p04-v04 (4)
He / Bhairava / god / world-bearing-characterized / in-own-self-vision / whole / by-power / reflected // bod-p04
l2: He alone is Bhairava, the god whose very mark is bearing the world. In the mirror of His own self-seeing, the whole stands reflected — by power.
l3:
He alone is Bhairava, the world-bearing god;
in His own seeing's mirror stands the whole, mirrored by power.

sanskrit: tasyaivaiṣā parā devī svarūpāmarśanotsukā | pūrṇatvaṃ sarvabhaveṣu yasyā nālpaṃ na cādhikam
l1:
## bod-p05-v05 (5)
Of-him-alone / supreme / goddess / own-nature-grasping-eager / fullness / in-all-beings / of-whom / neither-little / nor / excess // bod-p05
l2: His alone is the supreme goddess, hungry only to grasp His own nature. She is fullness in all beings — in whom there is neither too little nor too much.
l3:
His alone is the goddess supreme, hungry to grasp His nature;
fullness in all beings — never little, never more.

sanskrit: eṣa devo 'nayā devyā nityaṃ krīḍārasotsukaḥ | vicitrān sṛṣṭisaṃhārān vidhatte yugapad vibhuḥ
l1:
## bod-p06-v06 (6)
This / god / by-this / goddess / always / play-joy-eager / varied / creation-dissolution / does / simultaneously / all-pervading // bod-p06
l2: This god, with this goddess, is forever eager for the joy of play. Varied makings and unmakings He works at once — everywhere at once.
l3:
This god, with this goddess, forever eager for play's delight;
varied makings and unmakings He works at once — the all-pervading.

sanskrit: atidurghaṭakāritvam asyānuttaram eva yat | etad eva svatantratvam aisvaryaṃ bodharūpatā
l1:
## bod-p07-v07 (7)
Hard-to-accomplish / of-it / unsurpassed / indeed / what / that-itself / autonomy / lordship / awareness-form // bod-p07
l2: What is hardest to do is His, and it is unsurpassed. That itself is His freedom, His lordship, His awareness-form.
l3:
What is hardest to do is His — and none is higher;
that itself is freedom, lordship, awareness-nature.

sanskrit: paricchinnaprakāśatvaṃ jaḍasya kila lakṣaṇam | jaḍād vilakṣaṇo bodho yato na parimīyate
l1:
## bod-p08-v08 (8)
Limited-light-ness / of-inert / indeed / mark / from-inert / different / awareness / since / not / measured // bod-p08
l2: To shine only in part — that is the mark of the inert. Awareness is otherwise than the inert, for no measure contains it.
l3:
To shine only in part — that is the mark of the inert;
awareness stands apart from the inert, for it cannot be measured.

sanskrit: evam asya svatantrasya nijaśaktyupabhedinaḥ | svātmagāḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārāḥ svarūpatvena saṃsthitāḥ
l1:
## bod-p09-v09 (9)
Thus / of-it / autonomous / by-own-power-distinction / own-self / creation-dissolution / as-nature / stand // bod-p09
l2: So it is with the free one, distinguishing by His own power: makings and unmakings rest in His own self, standing as His very nature.
l3:
So of the free one, discerning by his own power,
makings and unmakings rest in his own self, standing as his nature.

sanskrit: teṣu vaicitryam atyantam ūrdhvādhas tiryag eva yat | bhuvanāni tadaṃśāś ca sukhaduḥkhamatiś ca yā
l1:
## bod-p10-v10 (10)
In-them / variety / extreme / up-down / across / what / worlds / their-parts / pleasure-pain-mind / what // bod-p10
l2: In them, variety runs to the extreme — upward, downward, across. Worlds and their fragments, pleasure and pain and mind.
l3:
In them, variety runs to the uttermost — high, low, athwart;
worlds and their fragments, pleasure, pain, and mind.

sanskrit: yad etasyāparijñānaṃ tatsvātantryaṃ hi varṇitam | sa eva khalu saṃsāro mūḍānāṃ yo vibhīṣakaḥ
l1:
## bod-p11-v11 (11)
What / of-it / non-knowledge / that / its-autonomy / thus / it / indeed / saṃsāra / of-fools / who / terrifying // bod-p11
l2: Not to know this is called His freedom. And that is saṃsāra itself — a terror to the deluded.
l3:
Not to know this is called His freedom — that is told;
and that itself is saṃsāra — to the deluded, a terror.

sanskrit: tatprasādarasād eva gurvāgamata eva vā | śāstrād vā parameśasya yasmāt kasmād upāgatam
l1:
## bod-p12-v12 (12)
From-that / grace-sap / or / from-teacher-scripture / or / from-scripture / of-supreme-Lord / from-which / from-which / approached // bod-p12
l2: From the sap of His grace, or from the teacher's handed word, or from the Lord's own scripture — from whichever, it is reached.
l3:
From grace's sap, or the teacher's handed word,
or the Lord's own scripture — from wherever, it is reached.

sanskrit: yat tattvasya parijñānaṃ sa mokṣaḥ parameśataḥ | tat pūrṇatvaṃ prabuddhānāṃ jīvanmuktiś ca sā smṛtā
l1:
## bod-p13-v13 (13)
What / of-reality / full-knowledge / that / liberation / from-supreme-Lord / That / fullness / of-awakened / living-liberation / that / remembered // bod-p13
l2: To know reality through and through — that is release, from the supreme Lord. That is the fullness of the awakened: freedom while living, as the remembered teaching holds.
l3:
To know the real through and through — release, from the supreme Lord;
that is the awakened's fullness: while living, free — as is remembered.

sanskrit: etau bandhavimokṣau ca parameśasvarūpataḥ | na bhidyete na bhedo hi tattvataḥ parameśvare
l1:
## bod-p14-v14 (14)
These-two / bondage / liberation / from-supreme-Lord-nature / Not / they-differ / no / difference / in-truth / in-supreme-Lord // bod-p14
l2: Bondage and release both come of the Lord's own nature. The two do not split apart; in truth, in the supreme Lord, there is no split.
l3:
Bondage and release, both from the Lord's own nature, never part;
in truth, in the Lord, there is no split.

sanskrit: ittham icchākalājñānaśaktiśūlāmbujāśritaḥ | bhairavaḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ svabhāvaḥ pariśīlyate
l1:
## bod-p15-v15 (15)
Thus / will-power / art / knowledge / power / trident / lotus / resorted / Bhairava / of-all-things / own-nature / is-examined // bod-p15
l2: So it is: resting on the lotus of the trident — will, art, knowledge, power — Bhairava, the own-nature of all things, is to be dwelt upon.
l3:
Thus, resting on will, art, knowledge, power, trident, lotus —
Bhairava, the own-nature of all things, is to be contemplated.
